**Source slice implemented; release preparation blocked.**

- Preserved the existing 18 `tched_plugins`/`tched_skills` wrapper removals.
- Removed router `get`, `init`, `list`, `set`, `patch` and `binary_namespace.rs`; retained typed configuration APIs.
- Reconciled host mount selection, two workspace symlink targets, and matching documentation.
- Added pre-spawn refusal for unsupported `skills.edit` and `skills.add --edit`.
- Kept native capabilities unchanged—no legacy grant aliases or permission broadening.

All 18 wrapper mappings and 43 router dispositions are recorded in `reports/threetched-consolidation-handoff-20261018.md`. Broader consolidation remains deferred as documented; OD-122/OD-123 remain untouched.

**Build blocker:** the execution worker found Cargo check PID `25761` and rustc PIDs `25784/25788/25794` occupying the compiler slot (`artifact://16`). The authorized GNU release build **did not start**. No fresh isolated catalog or regenerated specialization artifacts were produced.

Tests, Clippy, formatting and custom smoke checks were not run. Nothing was installed, activated or restarted. Live mounted metadata still showed generation 74 with four upstream plugin IDs.

Next prerequisite: compiler ownership clears, then GNU release build → fresh isolated seal → exact catalog-delta review and specialization regeneration. Shared HANDOFF, SIGNALS and WISHLIST contain the blocker and next action.
